title: Reflexivity of the restricted symplectic form
statement: Fix a prime $p$, a natural number $n$, and a subset $M \subseteq \{0,1,\dots,n-1\}$, and let $V_M$ be the associated support submodule of $V = \bbf_p^{\,n} \times \bbf_p^{\,n}$. Then the restriction to $V_M$ of the symplectic form $\omega(u,v) = \sum_{i} (x_i z'_i - z_i x'_i)$, where $u=(x,z)$ and $v=(x',z')$, is reflexive: for all $u, v \in V_M$, if $\omega(u,v) = 0$ then $\omega(v,u) = 0$.
hypotheses_covered: the index set is Fin n
M is a finset of Fin n
the form is the symplectic form restricted to the support submodule V_M
replaced: The restricted symplectic form on $V_M$ is reflexive.
